name: Arroyo Grande Valley
terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

notes: A long, cool growing season near the Pacific gives ripe flavor while the grapes keep their natural acidity.
Wines across the San Luis Obispo Coast share an energetic acidity and vibrancy.

blurb.text: A valley AVA in San Luis Obispo County, now within the San Luis Obispo Coast AVA, where Pacific marine air brings frequent fog. Chardonnay and Pinot Noir are the main grapes, grown in the cooler mid-valley, while Zinfandel, Petite Sirah and Rhone varieties are grown on the higher elevations near Lopez Lake.
